messages.content: The Homewood just emailed that its garage will be closed Friday evening. We are not changing hotels, but I need a workable parking plan that will not make us late for dinner.
I’ll check the closure window, nearby overnight parking, and whether you can unload at the hotel before moving the car. What time do you now expect to reach Nashville?
Still about 5:30 p.m. Central. Dinner at the Hutton is at 7:00, and we will take a rideshare there as planned.

The hotel confirms that the garage will be inaccessible Friday from 3:00 p.m. until 7:00 a.m. Saturday. Its front drive will remain open for brief unloading and check-in. Staff are directing guests to the Vanderbilt 25th Avenue Garage, about 0.3 mile away, and overnight parking is permitted there.
Is that parking covered by the hotel, or do we pay separately? And can we leave the car there until Saturday morning?

Homewood will provide a Friday-night overflow voucher at check-in, so there is no added parking charge. The voucher is valid through 10:00 a.m. Saturday. After the hotel garage reopens at 7:00 a.m., you can move the car back there for the remainder of the stay.
Then confirm exactly how the luggage drop should work. I do not want one of us circling while the other waits for a pass.

The desk says you may stop in the front drive, unload both bags, and leave the car there for up to 15 minutes. One of you can check in and collect the overflow voucher while the other remains with the car. The drive to the overflow garage is about two minutes, followed by a six-minute walk back.
Good. Put that plan on the reservation and leave every other part of the booking alone.

The hotel added the arrival and parking note to confirmation HWV-482731 without changing the room, refundable rate, guests, or dates. Friday plan: arrive near 5:30 p.m. Central, unload in the front drive, check in and collect the overflow voucher, park at the Vanderbilt 25th Avenue Garage, then rideshare from the hotel to the 7:00 p.m. dinner at the Hutton. Move the car into Homewood’s garage by 10:00 a.m. Saturday. No additional parking cost was added.
